Registration is due now

All dogs over the age of three months must be registered. Pay by 1 August to avoid late fees.

See all key dates

Reform of Local Government

Central Government has given us three months to develop an amalgamation proposal - combining Tararua with other councils in our region. Over the past few weeks, we've been talking with our community about the options and what people most (or least) want to see happen.
